title: 柠檬蛋糕与敏锐眼睛  (Lemon Cake and Sharp Eyes)

segments.t: Out in the courtyard, Mei sets down a plate of warm glazed lemon cake for Peng and Hao. Between bites, observant older brother Peng glances toward the lobby window. Listen first.
刚出炉的：星期五柠檬蛋糕，多切了边角！
咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟梧桐巷的味道一模一样！
宋老师早上讲了我们星期五的故事，小美特意烤的。
老弟，你到底撞进了一家什么神奇客栈？
一家雨夜修阁楼台灯、还替陌生人守箱子的客栈。
那你告诉我，前台后面那位先生为什么快哭了？
哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
小美，里面出什么事了？热水管又漏水了吗？
比水管严重……中午房东寄来了一封挂号信。
房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
等等，志鹏——你还在市政厅合同科工作？！
你们两位都懂？！放下茶杯——现在立刻跟我进来！
Now let's walk through the scene, one line at a time.
刚出炉的：星期五柠檬蛋糕，多切了边角！
'Fresh from the oven: Friday lemon cake, with extra corner pieces!' Bakery favourite:
出炉
literally 'exit the furnace', means 'fresh out of the oven'.
咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟梧桐巷的味道一模一样！
'One bite... Zhihao, close your eyes! It tastes identical to Wutong Lane!' Sensory noun
味道
covers both taste on the tongue and scent in the air.
老弟，你到底撞进了一家什么神奇客栈？
'Little brother, what kind of magical inn did you stumble into?' Pressing for the real answer uses
到底
literally 'to the bottom'—'what on earth kind of inn?'.
一家雨夜修阁楼台灯、还替陌生人守箱子的客栈。
'One that fixes attic lamps on a rainy night and guards a stranger's bag.' Built from 'unfamiliar' plus 'person',
陌生人
is Mandarin's everyday word for a stranger.
哎呀！透过窗户看见周经理了？我明明加倍用力微笑了！
'Oh dear! You spotted Manager Zhou through the window? I smiled twice as wide!' Expressing 'clearly' when things went differently uses
明明
as in 'I clearly smiled twice as hard!'.
小美，里面出什么事了？热水管又漏水了吗？
'Mei, is something wrong inside? Did the hot-water pipe leak again?' Household trouble word:
漏水
joins 'leak' with 'water' for any dripping pipe or roof.
比水管严重……中午房东寄来了一封挂号信。
'Worse than a pipe... at noon a registered letter arrived from the landlord.' Official mail term:
挂号信
literally 'registered-number letter', names registered post you sign for.
你们两位都懂？！放下茶杯——现在立刻跟我进来！
'Both of you?! Put down your teacups—come inside with me this instant!' Urgent cousin of 'right away':
立刻
means 'this very instant without a second's delay'. Now let's hear the whole scene again without stopping.
刚出炉的：星期五柠檬蛋糕，多切了边角！
咬一口……志豪，闭上眼睛！跟梧桐巷的味道一模一样！
宋老师早上讲了我们星期五的故事，小美特意烤的。

比水管严重……中午房东寄来了一封挂号信。
房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
等等，志鹏——你还在市政厅合同科工作？！
你们两位都懂？！放下茶杯——现在立刻跟我进来！
Not only is Hao a historic courtyard architect, Peng works at City Hall's municipal contract desk. Let's hurry inside to the front desk next time. See you next time.
回头见！
